cases.name: Carrie Ann Aring Price
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Carrie grew up in The Hill Country of Central Texas. She spent many years in the Lake Buchanan area, played sports in school, graduated from Marble Falls High School and attended college at Texas A&M in College Station and later at Texas Tech University. Carrie was well loved in the communities she lived in and brought life and laughter everywhere she went."
cases.narrative: She died in the hospital two days later.
